concept: ECS on EC2 + Spot/Savings Plans for constant high load
tests: Choosing the cheapest container compute for steady 24/7 high utilization when the team is willing to manage infrastructure.
expected: ECS on the EC2 launch type with Spot Instances or Compute Savings Plans — lowest unit price at constant utilization. Triggers: "steady, high CPU 24/7", "lowest possible compute cost", "willing to manage infrastructure".
why_not: Lambda is limited to 15 minutes and expensive at constant high volume; Fargate (ECS or EKS) removes operations but at a premium over optimized EC2.
